# BitmapLayer

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Render a raster image at specified boundaries.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/bitmap-layer",
  "type": "BitmapLayerOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/bitmap-layer').par.visible` (an input) and `op('/bitmap-layer').out.layer` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.visible`, `out.layer`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `visible` | `BooleanField` | `true` |
| `opacity` | `NumberField` | `1` |
| `image` | `FileUrlField` | `""` |
| `bounds` | `BboxField` | `{"southwest":{"lng":-122.5,"lat":37.7},"northeast":{"lng":-122.3,"lat":37.9}}` |
| `desaturate` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `transparentColor` | `ColorField` | `null` |
| `tintColor` | `ColorField` | `null` |
| `parameters` | `CompoundPropsField` | `{"depthTest":true}` |
| `extensions` | `ListField` | `[]` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->
